text: ok, i rebuilt, and it still is choking out. i drop to 22 fps with 54.7ms average
resolution: Batched the Studio selection/wireframe overlay. It drew one Box per edge + per dot (~2000 reconciler nodes), capped at MAX_CHILDREN=512 (only ~1/3 of a dense wireframe showed) and melting fps to 22fps/54ms; rig mode at 240fps proved the overlay was the choke. Added a 'segments' mode to Graph.Polyline — a polyline_segments node flag (framework/layout.zig), parsed from polylineSegments in v8_app.zig, consumed in engine.zig paint by stepping the point array in PAIRS so ONE node draws N disjoint capsule lines (instanced, analytic AA, no cap) instead of a connected strip. The wireframe is now one Graph.Polyline segments node and the dots one Boxxx instanced-rect batch — ~2000 nodes collapse to a handful of batched GPU draws. User confirmed 'works great'. TSX + framework change (user rebuilt).
